name: Ancien charpentier
description: Lean elderly adult, weathered pale ochre-grey face, long grey dreadlocks loosely tied behind, narrow exposed mandibles with a short natural tusk, faint old brow mark. Long grey canvas coat tucked clear of feet, green shoulder capelet, worn steel forearm protection. Carefully holds a short folding measuring rule and a small timber joint sample fastened in one hand, belt of chisels in covered pouches. Slight dignified stoop.
